restatement_context.purpose: Honest non-candidate restatement after the frozen engine failed read-only accounting audit. Not a rescue, not a new validation candidate, no parameter search. The original pre-registered 15% funding-of-short-notional gate remains binding and is recorded as FAILED.

confirmed_defects_repaired.D1_signed_funding: frozen run.py:152 'out[ts] = max(float(p[2]), out.get(ts, 0.0))' clipped every standalone negative rate to zero (zero snap collisions in audited archives, so it was a pure sign clip). Repaired: exact signed rate; duplicate snapped events raise. Impact table below.
confirmed_defects_repaired.D2_actual_notional_yield: frozen run.py:518 used notional = eq_close/2 (mean denominators 0.813293 BTC / 1.279368 ETH) while actual mean short notional was 2.899141 / 4.385734: reported yields inflated ~3.5x. Repaired: yields normalize by actual |q_p|*P over held hours.
confirmed_defects_repaired.D3_fully_funded_entry: frozen run.py:356-364 bought spot with the whole sleeve (K = C/(1+f), cash exactly 0) and reserved zero USD-M margin: entry gross 4K = 1.9962 per 1.0 NAV (~2.0x), 2024 mean gross/equity 3.475, mean combined negative cash -6.00 per initial dollar = borrowing/cross-collateral, violating contract. Repaired: independent 100% collateral, gross <= 1.0x NAV at entry, margin-call termination at 0.5% maintenance, no borrowing.
confirmed_defects_repaired.D4_sofr: frozen run.py:448 'sofr.get(d_date, 0.0)/DAY_DENOM' accrued zero on non-publication days (116 of 366 days in 2024) with /365 denominator. Repaired: carried-forward rate, ACT/360.
